place: a hospital corridor where every door is the same

hero.name: Max
hero.look: a tired man in his late twenties in a creased work shirt, unshaven

soul.diary: Visited dad in hospital today, talked about football for an hour and left. He looked small.
wants: to say the real thing to his dad
to not be the one in charge
fears: that there is not much time
breaking down in front of his dad
soul.past_dream: I dreamed I was running in a corridor and the floor numbers went backwards.

facts.text: His dad taught him to fix bikes.
He brought a letter for his dad and did not give it.

situation_hero: you just woke up on a bench in a long hospital corridor; every door has the same number; two nurses walk up arguing about you

actors.name: Nurse Vik
actors.look: a tall brisk nurse with a clipboard and red sneakers
actors.persona: Nurse Vik: fast, practical, wants Max to go into room 12 right now and stop wasting time. She argues with Nurse Oz. She is hiding that she has been told the patient may not wake up tomorrow.

actors.name: Nurse Oz
actors.look: a soft-spoken male nurse with a cardigan over scrubs, tea in hand
actors.persona: Nurse Oz: slow, kind, tells Max to sit and have tea first, nothing is urgent. He argues with Nurse Vik and teases her. He is hiding that he lost his own father without saying goodbye.
